disposition_reason: FDA OTC Monograph M016 (skin protectant drug products) lists cocoa butter 50 to 100 percent as a permitted skin-protectant active ingredient and a labeling provision for products containing only cocoa butter/petrolatum; non-food drug use, no metal occurrence or limit for cocoa.
disposition_locator: PDF p.2 §M016.10(d) 'Cocoa butter, 50 to 100 percent'; PDF p.10 labeling paragraph (f) referencing §M016.10(d), (m), (r)

study.material_scope: cocoa butter as topical skin-protectant drug ingredient (non-food)
